Tetelestai project SEO

Tuber Towing & Recovery

Towing company, Edmonton and Spruce Grove, Alberta. WordPress with WooCommerce store.

Technical SEOCore Web VitalsForms
tubertowing.ca · WPCode
// Preload Hero Image, front page only
add_action('wp_head', function () {
  if ( is_front_page() ) {
    echo '<link rel="preload" as="image"
      fetchpriority="high" href="hero.webp">';
  }
}, 1);
LCP hero now loads first

Ongoing SEO and maintenance across blog posts, service pages and the store, with every fix documented in daily reports.

  • IssueSearch Console showed product filter URLs as "Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt." Google could not crawl them to see their canonical tags.
  • FixSeparated filter and pagination parameters from cart actions, so filter rules can be lifted for canonical consolidation while cart URLs stay blocked.
  • IssueSlow LCP on the homepage. Elementor hardcodes loading="lazy" on hero images, and attribute overrides only reach the wrapper div.
  • FixAdded a high-priority image preload through a WPCode snippet scoped to the front page.
  • IssueForced reflow from Elementor and jQuery running under WP Rocket's delayed and deferred JavaScript.
  • FixAdded targeted manual exclusions for jQuery Migrate and the sticky script in both WP Rocket JS settings.
  • IssueSemrush broken links that did not exist in the visible Elementor content.
  • FixTraced them through page source to pingback comment URLs and raw HTML text blocks, then fixed them at the source.
  • Issue2,283 spam entries on the contact form exhausted the host's daily email limit.
  • FixCleared the backlog and layered a honeypot, reCAPTCHA v2 and tuned entry limits on the form.
  • ContentHeading hierarchy, RankMath pixel-width titles and descriptions, and FAQPage schema kept separate from Article schema, deployed through WPCode and Tag Manager.

Tetelestai project Performance

Tuber Towing staff portal

Login-gated internal knowledge base and forms portal for towing staff.

Database performanceCaching
team portal · query log
SELECT * FROM gf_entry_meta WHERE entry_id = 101
SELECT * FROM gf_entry_meta WHERE entry_id = 102
SELECT * FROM gf_entry_meta WHERE entry_id = 103
... repeated per entry (N+1)

W3 Total Cache: Page cache → Disk
Bug filed with GravityKit
  • IssueHigh query counts and slow pages. GravityView was calling entry lookups repeatedly against the entry meta table, an N+1 pattern.
  • FixDocumented the bug and filed a formal support ticket with GravityKit with reproduction details.
  • IssueNo Memcached, Redis or object caching available on the host.
  • FixConfigured W3 Total Cache with disk-based caching and flagged hosting options for an upgrade decision.
